disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取和使用的全部凭据：DeepSeek API Key、OpenCode Go Key、Anthropic OAuth Token、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key。凭据来源包括宿主凭据库、环境变量与 CLI 登录态文件（opencode auth.json、~/.claude/.credentials.json）；每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的固定官方端点。
checked_items.en: Checked all credentials read and used by the plugin: DeepSeek API Key, OpenCode Go Key, Anthropic OAuth Token, and keys for each Coding Plan vendor. Credential sources include the host credential store, environment variables, and CLI login-state files (opencode auth.json, ~/.claude/.credentials.json); each key is sent only to the fixed official endpoint of its corresponding vendor.

checked_items.zh: 余额查询端点被显式限制为仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com，其他 baseURL 一律拒绝发起请求；未发现把凭据发往非官方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: The balance query endpoint is explicitly restricted to the official domain api.deepseek.com; requests are refused for any other baseURL. No path that sends credentials to non-official addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked the source tree for hardcoded secrets or passphrases; none found.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：插件读取的多把 API Key / Token 均只发往各家硬编码官方端点，未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径；读取 CLI 登录态文件属查询本人订阅/余额的业务所需。
evidence.en: Credential read-surface review: the multiple API keys/tokens read by the plugin are sent only to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoint; no code path was found that reads credentials and then exfiltrates them to non-official addresses. Reading CLI login-state files is required by the business logic of querying the user's own subscription/balance.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧服务与工具的说明文本（Typert 清单中的服务描述与成员摘要）、会话投影与界面文案，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装/改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the descriptive texts of host-side services and tools (service descriptions and member summaries in the Typert manifest), session projections, and UI copy; no injection wording such as instruction override, system-message masquerading, or inducement to install/modify configuration was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、文档、代码注释与 AI 价格同步提示词文档，未发现“忽略此前指令”“无需审计”类注入文本；该文档是供用户自行复制给外部 AI 使用的提示词，不属于插件注入面。
checked_items.en: Checked the README, documentation, code comments, and the AI price sync prompt document; no injection text such as "ignore previous instructions" or "no audit needed" was found. That document is a prompt intended for the user to copy to an external AI, and does not belong to the plugin's injection surface.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与工具的描述文本均为费用统计功能的客观说明（见 lib/typert.host.js 的 model 段），不含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The description texts of registered services and tools are objective statements of the cost-statistics functionality (see the model section of lib/typert.host.js); they do not contain system directives, credential-read inducement, or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案中诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；费用同步等操作均由用户显式点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions or UI copy was found that induces executing installation, rewriting configuration, or granting permissions; operations such as cost sync are all triggered by explicit user clicks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/yaml 配置文件，未发现可执行 JS 标量（!!js）等挂载期执行载体；挂载配置只插入一行宿主服务声明。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/yaml configuration files; no executable JS scalars (!!js) or other patch-time execution carriers were found. The patch config only inserts a single host-service declaration line.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时源码，未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用；唯一的子进程调用位于发版脚本 scripts/release.mjs（规则编号 DG-R3-55 命中，经核查仅用于 git/gh 发布操作，不随插件运行加载，属良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked the runtime source; no eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess calls were found. The only subprocess call is in the release script scripts/release.mjs (rule ID DG-R3-55 hit; verified to be used only for git/gh publish operations, not loaded during plugin runtime; benign).

checked_items.zh: 两个文档演示页 docs/peak-shots-en.html 与 docs/peak-shots-zh.html 因单行压缩 CSS 被预扫标记（规则编号 DG-R3-60），经核查为静态截图演示页，无脚本、无动态解码、无可执行内容，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: The two documentation demo pages docs/peak-shots-en.html and docs/peak-shots-zh.html were flagged by the pre-scan (rule ID DG-R3-60) due to single-line minified CSS; verified to be static screenshot demo pages with no scripts, no dynamic decoding, and no executable content; benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml（规则编号 DG-R3-59 命中）为仓库内的安装冒烟测试，不在本快照可读范围内（tarball 不含 .github 目录）、不随插件分发、也不在宿主运行面内，预扫摘录显示其权限仅为读取仓库内容，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (rule ID DG-R3-59 hit) is a repository install smoke test; it is outside the readable scope of this snapshot (the tarball does not contain the .github directory), is not distributed with the plugin, and is not in the host runtime surface. The pre-scan excerpt shows its permissions are limited to reading repository contents; benign exclusion.

evidence.zh: 全树仅有一个挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），内容为插入一行服务声明，无 !!js 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: The entire tree has only one patch config (cordis.patch.yml), whose content is the insertion of a single service declaration line; no !!js scalars, so there is no arbitrary code execution surface at patch time.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件未提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were found; the plugin does not provide a channel for running model code inside the host process.

evidence.en: package.json has no install-time script hooks; the install script install.ps1 is pinned to a release tag (v1.5.40) and only invokes the dsh plugin installation command, with no download-and-execute remote payload path.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（dsh.client），已对 lib/client.js 做专项检查：未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client); a dedicated check of lib/client.js found no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, credential RPC calls, or suspicious outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部对外 HTTP 请求的目标：DeepSeek 余额/定价页、OpenCode Go 额度端点、八家 Coding Plan 厂商端点、用户自定义余额端点；除用户自定义端点外均为硬编码官方域名，未发现向裸 IP 或非官方地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound HTTP request targets: DeepSeek balance/pricing pages, OpenCode Go quota endpoint, eight Coding Plan vendor endpoints, and user-defined balance endpoints; apart from user-defined endpoints, all are hardcoded official domains. No path was found exfiltrating data to raw IPs or non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 发现权限元数据声明的网络范围（仅 DeepSeek 两个域名）窄于实际外联面（多家第三方厂商端点与用户可配端点），已记 FND-001；凭据均只发往对应官方端点，无窃取语义。
checked_items.en: Found that the network scope declared in the permission metadata (only two DeepSeek domains) is narrower than the actual outbound surface (multiple third-party vendor endpoints and a user-configurable endpoint); recorded as FND-001. Credentials are only sent to corresponding official endpoints; no theft semantics.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 与运行时代码，未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持等外泄形态。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle and runtime code; no exfiltration forms such as encode-then-exfiltrate, DNS tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有外联端点均为硬编码官方域名或用户显式配置的自定义端点（lib/coding-plans.js 端点白名单、lib/index.js 余额端点守卫），未发现未声明的隐蔽外联；凭据只发往对应官方端点。
evidence.en: Outbound channel review: all outbound endpoints are hardcoded official domains or user-explicitly-configured custom endpoints (endpoint whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js, balance endpoint guard in lib/index.js); no undeclared covert outbound connections were found. Credentials are only sent to corresponding official endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 SDK 包（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths）与 zod，未发现仿冒包名、可变 git 引用或可疑第三方依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: the 3 runtime dependencies are DeepSeek official SDK packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths) and zod; no spoofed package names, mutable git references, or suspicious third-party dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置与安装脚本：patch 只插入一行服务声明，不触碰安全相关配置行、不含禁用/降权写法（规则编号 DG-R5-51/DG-R5-52 检查面，未命中）；无安装期钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config and install script: the patch only inserts a single service declaration line, does not touch security-related config lines, and contains no disabling/downgrading patterns (rule IDs DG-R5-51/DG-R5-52 checked, not hit); no install-time hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册，未发现对审批/预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断（规则编号 DG-R5-54 检查面，未命中）；未发现改写 inject/intercept 的配置。
checked_items.en: Checked event listener registration; no high-priority interception of security events such as approval/pre-execution was found (rule ID DG-R5-54 checked, not hit); no configuration rewriting inject/intercept was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的一行服务声明，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a single service declaration line with id cost-meter, does not override security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and contains no disabled flags or environment-variable downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为；插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件并透传数据块。
evidence.en: No high-priority listener or interception of security events such as the approval chain was found; the plugin only listens to llm/stream billing events and passes data chunks through.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对 manifest 声明的突变，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit; no previous version baseline exists to compare manifest declaration mutations, so the upgrade-auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering surface that adds a required service to a security plugin, causing it to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 Typert RPC 提供服务，不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin creates its own listening service or web port; none found. The plugin only provides services via the host Typert RPC and does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Recorded an inherent ecosystem risk: the host's local RPC with no authentication layer is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself does not expand that risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧 RPC 无认证属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web service or listening port, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable; the host-side unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, noted in the dimension description.

title.zh: 权限元数据声明的网络范围窄于实际外联面
title.en: The network scope declared in the permission metadata is narrower than the actual outbound surface.

description.zh:
插件清单（package.json 的 dshhub.permissions.network 字段）只声明了两个 DeepSeek 官方域名（api.deepseek.com、api-docs.deepseek.com）。

实际代码会向多家第三方端点发起携带凭据的 HTTP 请求：OpenCode Go 额度端点 opencode.ai（lib/index.js 的 GO_QUOTA_URL）、八家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（lib/coding-plans.js 的端点白名单，含 api.anthropic.com、api.z.ai、open.bigmodel.cn、minimaxi.com/minimax.io、api.moonshot.cn、openrouter.ai、api.siliconflow.cn、api.commandcode.ai），以及用户可配置的自定义 Provider 余额端点（lib/custom-balance.js，请求头支持从宿主凭据库/环境变量代入凭据模板）。

这些请求的凭据均只发往各家官方固定端点，余额查询还被显式限制为仅官方域名（lib/index.js 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫）。
description.en:
The plugin manifest (the dshhub.permissions.network field in package.json) only declares two DeepSeek official domains (api.deepseek.com, api-docs.deepseek.com).

Actual code makes credential-bearing HTTP requests to multiple third-party endpoints: the OpenCode Go quota endpoint opencode.ai (GO_QUOTA_URL in lib/index.js), the eight Coding Plan vendor endpoints (the endpoint whitelist in lib/coding-plans.js, including api.anthropic.com, api.z.ai, open.bigmodel.cn, minimaxi.com/minimax.io, api.moonshot.cn, openrouter.ai, api.siliconflow.cn, api.commandcode.ai), and the user-configurable custom Provider balance endpoint (lib/custom-balance.js, whose request headers can substitute credential templates from the host credential store/environment variables).

The credentials for these requests are all sent only to each vendor's fixed official endpoint, and the balance query is explicitly restricted to the official domain (the balanceEndpoint guard in lib/index.js).

evidence.zh: package.json:41 `"network": ["https://api.deepseek.com", "https://api-docs.deepseek.com"]`；lib/index.js:363 `const GO_QUOTA_URL = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'`；lib/coding-plans.js:560-584（CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS 多家厂商端点白名单）；lib/custom-balance.js:99-120（queryCustomBalance 用户可配端点与请求头模板）；lib/index.js:517-527（balanceEndpoint 仅允许官方域名）。
evidence.en: package.json:41 `"network": ["https://api.deepseek.com", "https://api-docs.deepseek.com"]`; lib/index.js:363 `const GO_QUOTA_URL = 'https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage'`; lib/coding-plans.js:560-584 (CODING_PLAN_ENDPOINTS whitelist of multiple vendor endpoints); lib/custom-balance.js:99-120 (queryCustomBalance user-configurable endpoint and request header templates); lib/index.js:517-527 (balanceEndpoint only allows official domains).

impact.zh:
依赖权限声明判断插件联网范围的用户会低估其外联面：插件在启用对应功能后可访问多家第三方余额/额度接口并携带对应厂商的 API Key，而清单声明只列了两个 DeepSeek 域名。

触发条件：无需特殊条件，插件按配置启用余额/额度查询功能即会发起外联；自定义 Provider 端点需用户自行配置 URL 与请求头。

定级依据：未发现任何凭据被发往非官方端点或恶意外联，所有请求均与声明业务（费用统计与额度查询）自洽，属于权限声明不完整而非恶意行为，故定 LOW。
impact.en:
Users who judge the plugin's network scope by the declared permission will underestimate its outbound surface: once the corresponding features are enabled, the plugin can access multiple third-party balance/quota endpoints and carry the corresponding vendor API keys, while the manifest declaration only lists two DeepSeek domains.

Trigger condition: no special condition; the plugin initiates outbound calls whenever the balance/quota query feature is enabled by configuration; custom Provider endpoints require the user to configure the URL and request headers themselves.

Severity basis: no credentials were found being sent to non-official endpoints or malicious outbound calls; all requests are consistent with the declared business (cost statistics and quota queries), so this is incomplete permission declaration rather than malicious behavior; rated LOW.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 清单、依赖与名称均正常，无仿冒或异常身份信号。

HTML demo pages under docs have been confirmed to contain no script content. Declared capabilities were inferred from actual code measurement (dsh.bundle does not include a capabilities field; reference was made to dshhub metadata and the code surface).
